native_compiler.task: Run the actual bria-vgl Thales EditImages path with images=[A,B], or an explicitly identified compiler that produces the verified native edit schema. The final edit_prompt is the complete serialized native JSON, including a nonempty edit_instruction and its target caption. Use <image_1> for A and <image_2> for B. Record the actual VLM/provider, version, calls and any fallback; bria-vgl is not a pure local JSON conversion.

model_aware_guidance: Express the frozen changes as named target appearance attributes and object/region relations. Keep edit_instruction consistent with every corresponding target caption field. Use appearance language for tone mapping, retaining source illumination geometry; do not equate a lighting field with a calibrated exposure or tone curve.

capabilities.mask_semantics: The inspected Diffusers path thresholds at 128 and greys out the source region before encoding; it does not hard-copy unedited output pixels.
